purpose: Final source audit against the frozen pre-identity baseline. Differences are preserved independent donor/calibration changes, not an identity-only parity claim.

differences.before: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, about the CG, downwash settled; closed form 2*a_f*(S_t/S)*(l_t/c) = 3.13; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value was 6.1639
differences.after: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g, ARP-referred since D6e-R1): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, downwash settled; the wing ahead of the CG loses lift in a pull, so it is below the tail-only closed form 2*a_f*(S_t/S)*(l_t/c) = 3.13; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value was 6.1639

differences.before: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, about the CG, downwash settled; the downwash lag adds Cmadot -3.59 as a state (E0a2b), so Cmq+Cmadot = -11.07; closed-form tail -7.40; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -13.5664 lumped both
differences.after: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g, ARP-referred since D6e-R1): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim gives -7.741 about the CG, downwash settled; written about the ARP so the oracle's r x F transfer of the CLq lift reproduces it; the downwash lag adds Cmadot -3.59 as a state (E0a2b); closed-form tail -7.40; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -13.5664 lumped both

differences.before: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, about the CG, downwash settled; fin -2*(l_v/b)*Cnb_fin plus wing profile -CD0/3 = -0.1324 (D11f); the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -0.1833 contradicts the fin-derived Cnb
differences.after: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g, ARP-referred since D6e-R1): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim gives -0.1318 about the CG, downwash settled; written about the ARP so the oracle's r x F transfer of the CYr side force reproduces it; fin -2*(l_v/b)*Cnb_fin plus wing profile -CD0/3 = -0.1324 (D11f); the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -0.1833 contradicts the fin-derived Cnb

differences.before: docs/research/flight-repair-implementation.md: provisional surface model; estimated, not measured flight data; Cm0/Cma for horizontal effective incidence, vertical symmetric
differences.after: research/flight-dynamics/climb-trim/derive_tail_incidence.gd (D6e-R1): effective incidence at which the local model's static Cm equals the oracle's at the 15 m/s level trim (no trim step at the regime switch); with the ARP at the CG this rule reduced to the earlier Cm0/Cma = 0.03845 of docs/research/flight-repair-implementation.md; estimated provisional surface model, not measured flight data

aileron.source: Durafly Ugly Stik V2 manual (Version 2) p.8, a 1.1 m foam Ugly Stik: low/high rates elevator 10/20 mm, aileron 10/18 mm, rudder 12/18 mm either way from neutral; the low/high ratio is applied to this model's maximum throws (controls.max_throw).
